headline: LeviLauncher v1.5.22
summary: This update adds foreground service support, improved gyroscope sensitivity, an external mods catalog, mod scanning improvements, redesigned content management, and updated translations.

items.text: Added foreground service support to keep Minecraft active while the launcher is in the background.
Greatly increased gyroscope sensitivity and improved gyro controls.
Added an external mods catalog with built-in mod download functionality.
Added a Community Discord button and improved scanned mods so users can choose which mods to add.
Redesigned the custom flat world editor.
Redesigned content management lists for a cleaner and easier-to-use interface.
Updated and completed strings and translations across supported languages.
